script:
$configDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode"
$skillDir = "$configDir\skills\face-audit"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $skillDir | Out-Null
$b64 = ""
$bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$skillDir\SKILL.md", [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes))
"SKILL.md written"
Get-Content "$skillDir\SKILL.md" | Select-Object -First 5
